context.passage:
0 03
Kate Blum (9:17 A.M.)
Good morning, everyone. I just wanted to do a quick check to make certain
everything is in place for this Saturday's conference.
Ken Miyashiro (9:18 A.M.)
We're all set. And since the conference is sold out, we are going to broadcast it live
over the Internet so that people can watch it on their devices.
Yuri Kang (9:19 A.M.)
Is that completely arranged-camera operators, software, viewer access, and so
Ken Miyashiro (9:20 A.M.)
Yes. We've hired everyone, and we have the software, so we should be ready.
People who want to watch the conference over the Internet still have to register
and pay on our Web site, and then they'll get online access to see Tom Akana's
keynote address and all the scheduled conference sessions.
Gabriel Lontoc (9:22 A.M.)
It's wonderful that Tom Akana has agreed to speak. It will be interesting to hear
how he created Honalo Coffee Roasters and built it into a profitable company.
Kate Blum (9:23 A.M.)
He is pleased to do it. He thinks it could help others who want to start restaurants
or food-related businesses. OK. I think that's it. Let's meet again on Wednesday
morning.
